patterns.message: Message components must render props only; use hooks or chat-view props instead of runtime/store/stream/API internals.
Message components must not import protocol parsers directly.
chatRuntime only projects AgentStreamEvent plus runtime state into ChatRuntimeAction.
chat-stream is limited to pure stream session/run state utilities.
chat-store is limited to runtime reducer, turn_draft hydration, and finalize logic.
chat-view is limited to display projections and must not depend on API, runtime, store, hooks, or components.
